; Output of `z80dasm hello.com`, where hello.com is asm/examples/hello.asm
; assembled by z80asm. Matches hello.asm's real instruction stream exactly,
; including auto-generated labels (L010D for the DJNZ loop target, L0129
; for the JP NZ target).
;
; Unlike the version of this fixture originally checked in, this is the
; FULL file - no `-l LENGTH` bound is needed anymore. z80dasm now does
; recursive-traversal decoding: it follows JP/CALL/JR/RST targets from the
; org address instead of decoding straight through, so the embedded
; message strings starting at 0x134 (never reached as code - only ever
; loaded into DE as a data pointer for BDOS function 9) come out as
; correctly labeled DB bytes instead of being mis-decoded as instructions.
; See cpm/docs/ROADMAP.md's disassembler section for the fuller writeup.
        org 0100h

        LD DE,0134h             ; 0100: 11 34 01 
        LD C,09h                ; 0103: 0E 09 
        CALL 0005h              ; 0105: CD 05 00 
        LD B,05h                ; 0108: 06 05 
        LD HL,0000h             ; 010A: 21 00 00 
L010D:
        INC HL                  ; 010D: 23 
        DJNZ L010D              ; 010E: 10 FD 
        LD A,L                  ; 0110: 7D 
        CP 05h                  ; 0111: FE 05 
        JP NZ,L0129             ; 0113: C2 29 01 
        ADD A,30h               ; 0116: C6 30 
        LD E,A                  ; 0118: 5F 
        LD C,02h                ; 0119: 0E 02 
        CALL 0005h              ; 011B: CD 05 00 
        LD DE,0147h             ; 011E: 11 47 01 
        LD C,09h                ; 0121: 0E 09 
        CALL 0005h              ; 0123: CD 05 00 
        JP 0000h                ; 0126: C3 00 00 
L0129:
        LD DE,014Ah             ; 0129: 11 4A 01 
        LD C,09h                ; 012C: 0E 09 
        CALL 0005h              ; 012E: CD 05 00 
        JP 0000h                ; 0131: C3 00 00 
        DB 48h                  ; 0134: 48 
        DB 65h                  ; 0135: 65 
        DB 6Ch                  ; 0136: 6C 
        DB 6Ch                  ; 0137: 6C 
        DB 6Fh                  ; 0138: 6F 
        DB 20h                  ; 0139: 20 
        DB 66h                  ; 013A: 66 
        DB 72h                  ; 013B: 72 
        DB 6Fh                  ; 013C: 6F 
        DB 6Dh                  ; 013D: 6D 
        DB 20h                  ; 013E: 20 
        DB 7Ah                  ; 013F: 7A 
        DB 38h                  ; 0140: 38 
        DB 30h                  ; 0141: 30 
        DB 61h                  ; 0142: 61 
        DB 73h                  ; 0143: 73 
        DB 6Dh                  ; 0144: 6D 
        DB 21h                  ; 0145: 21 
        DB 24h                  ; 0146: 24 
        DB 0Dh                  ; 0147: 0D 
        DB 0Ah                  ; 0148: 0A 
        DB 24h                  ; 0149: 24 
        DB 46h                  ; 014A: 46 
        DB 41h                  ; 014B: 41 
        DB 49h                  ; 014C: 49 
        DB 4Ch                  ; 014D: 4C 
        DB 3Ah                  ; 014E: 3A 
        DB 20h                  ; 014F: 20 
        DB 6Ch                  ; 0150: 6C 
        DB 6Fh                  ; 0151: 6F 
        DB 6Fh                  ; 0152: 6F 
        DB 70h                  ; 0153: 70 
        DB 20h                  ; 0154: 20 
        DB 63h                  ; 0155: 63 
        DB 6Fh                  ; 0156: 6F 
        DB 75h                  ; 0157: 75 
        DB 6Eh                  ; 0158: 6E 
        DB 74h                  ; 0159: 74 
        DB 65h                  ; 015A: 65 
        DB 72h                  ; 015B: 72 
        DB 20h                  ; 015C: 20 
        DB 77h                  ; 015D: 77 
        DB 72h                  ; 015E: 72 
        DB 6Fh                  ; 015F: 6F 
        DB 6Eh                  ; 0160: 6E 
        DB 67h                  ; 0161: 67 
        DB 24h                  ; 0162: 24
